- If Legal wants to review the DPA ahead of time, here’s a DocuSign preview link: https://www.docusign.com/HS-4732-dpa

Jonas (SE) and Karthik (compliance) will be on the call to walk through evidence locations and capture any follow-ups. We’ll record and share short clips for any stakeholders who can’t attend.
